anti_goal_violations.evidence: NEW finding, surfaced by this iteration's own QA window and re-derived first-hand by the evaluator (the auditor recorded it as B5 with a partly different attribution). Two unhandled MemoryErrors escaped to uvicorn as 'ERROR: Exception in ASGI application' at logs/backend.log:81850 and :81932, both AFTER this window's boot marker at :81466 ('launching at 2026-07-26T20:17:21Z'); both tracebacks end at app/api/evidence.py:34 get_evidence -> engine/evidence.py:153 build_evidence_payload -> forward_testing.py:2115 compute_drawdown_expectations_cached -> :1979 -> samples.py:923/145 -> research.py:215. The whole-file count went 13 -> 15, so the QA report's ':61' claim that the count is 'unchanged' is false (audit T1). The SAME MemoryError also aborted the background ingest-finalize path twice in that window via data_manager.py:3361 _refresh_ingest_aggregates -> ... -> research.py:242. Root cause read directly by the evaluator at apps/backend/app/engine/research.py:207-217: the ForwardReturn scan is column-projected and yield_per-bounded, but its results are accumulated into ret_by_run_symbol, an unbounded in-RAM dict keyed by every (run_id, symbol) pair in the table - an unbounded whole-table materialization in substance, on a request path, on the deep basis. NOT introduced by this iteration: research.py, samples.py, evidence.py and forward_testing.compute_drawdown_expectations are absent from the diff (7 files, all verified). Scored MINOR rather than critical on stated grounds, following the iter-26 precedent for a live 500 on a user-facing endpoint: the service was never taken down (GET /api/health answered 200 between the two failures and GET /api/backtest?as_of=2015-09-09 answered 200 immediately after), zero product code here is this iteration's, the host was simultaneously running this pipeline's own 200-test pytest against a ulimit -v cap, and every unblock path is agent-tractable. Recorded UNRESOLVED and routed as the next iteration's second work item. Two things unverified and stated rather than assumed: nobody captured a browser on /evidence at that moment, so AG-8's 'UI degrades gracefully / never a blank application-error page' half is again UNKNOWN; and no uvicorn access-log 500 line was emitted for either request, so what the client received is not recorded either. A reader who applies AG-8's 'exhaust a service's memory' clause literally would score this critical, which under decision tree C.1 means a REGRESSION halt instead of another agent iteration.
